script.story_title_en: The cost of changing your mind
script.logline_en: Ravi, a senior developer, recommends a software solution to his anxious colleague Priya during a tight deadline. Priya second-guesses him obsessively, switching decisions three times, until Ravi asks her a simple question about who pays the price for indecision.
script.originality_note_en: The ancient wisdom about decisive action is shown through modern workplace anxiety: a colleague frozen by doubt, a mentor learning when to push back, and the cost of wasted time that compounds every indecision.
script.meaning_ta: முடிவு எடுக்க வேண்டிய நேரத்தில், சிந்தித்து முடிவு எடுக்க வேண்டும். ஆனால் முடிவு எடுத்த பிறகு அதையே திரும்பத் திரும்பச் சந்தேகித்து மாற்றுவது வீனான செயல்.
script.meaning_en: Deliberate action requires careful thought before deciding, but endless second-guessing after commitment is waste. Think before you decide; then stand by your decision.

segments.speaker: ravi
segments.narration_ta: ப்ரியா, இந்த architecture தான் சரி. Implementation-ஐ நான் பாத்துக்கறேன்.

shots.action_en: Priya sits at her desk, looking stressed, with sticky notes around her workspace. She glances at the time on her monitor—close to deadline.

Her expression is anxious, eyes focused on her monitor, one hand raised to her chin in a worried gesture. Cool fluorescent office lighting mixed with warm window light from the left.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Priya's eyes dart from sticky note to monitor; she picks up her coffee cup, realizes it's cold, sets it back; her jaw clenches.

shots.action_en: Ravi points confidently to a diagram on the whiteboard while Priya listens, taking notes. Ravi's hand is steady, Priya's pen wavers.
shots.camera_en: Two-shot from slight angle, Ravi dominant on right.

shots.motion_prompt_en: Ravi's hand traces diagram lines smoothly; Priya nods but her fingers fidget with the pen.

shots.action_en: Priya types furiously, then stops, bites her lip, and swivels her chair toward Ravi's desk.
shots.camera_en: Side profile, Priya's stressed posture visible, swivel motion clear.
shots.image_prompt_en: Priya at her desk typing rapidly, then turning in her chair toward Ravi's adjacent desk. Her hair is messed, one strand loose from her pin. Multiple documents and sticky notes scattered across her workspace.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Quick typing motions, then Priya stops, thinks, and swivels her chair smoothly.

shots.action_en: Priya asks Ravi about alternatives while he's trying to work. His expression is patient but gradually tensing. They talk back and forth.
shots.camera_en: Over-the-shoulder from Ravi's perspective, Priya's face hopeful/anxious.
shots.image_prompt_en: Ravi at his desk looking at his monitor, Priya leaning over from her desk to talk to him. His expression patient but shoulders gradually tensing. Office background shows glass conference rooms out of focus.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Priya leans toward Ravi; Ravi turns to face her, nodding slowly; his hands rest on desk, fingers tap once; he leans back.

shots.action_en: Priya changes her mind again about a new framework. She covers her face with her hands in frustration, then pushes her chair back.
shots.camera_en: Close-up on Priya's face, eyes visible between fingers, then pulling hands away.
shots.image_prompt_en: Priya at her desk covering her face with both hands in frustration. Her shoulders are tensed. Front-side angle view. Multiple sticky notes visible, empty coffee cup on desk corner.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Priya covers her face and takes a deep breath, hands slowly lowering; she leans back in chair with defeated expression.

shots.action_en: Ravi looks up from his work, closes his laptop with a decisive motion, and stands. His body language shows he's made a decision. He approaches Priya.
shots.camera_en: Low angle, looking up at Ravi standing, determined and calm.
shots.image_prompt_en: Ravi at his desk closing his laptop with a firm motion, then standing up. His expression shows calm, kind determination. He adjusts his polo shirt sleeves. Office behind him slightly blurred.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Ravi's hands close the laptop firmly; he stands slowly, pushing his chair back; he adjusts his sleeves and walks toward Priya.

shots.action_en: Ravi and Priya stand at the window looking into the server room. Ravi gestures at the equipment, asking his pivotal question. Priya's expression shifts from anxious to understanding.
shots.camera_en: Two-shot, reflections in glass window, blue and amber equipment lights inside.
shots.image_prompt_en: Ravi and Priya at a window looking into a server room. Inside, racks of servers glow with blue and amber lights. Ravi is pointing, talking calmly with kind expression. Priya's reflection shows her listening intently, anxious expression softening.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Ravi gestures at servers; Priya nods slowly; their reflections move in glass; server lights provide ambient motion.

shots.action_en: Ravi stands at the whiteboard, writing the kural as he recites it. Words appear line by line in Tamil script.
shots.camera_en: Medium shot, Ravi in profile, marker moving across whiteboard, contemplative.
shots.image_prompt_en: Ravi in conference room at the whiteboard, writing Tamil text with black marker. His posture is teaching-like, calm and instructive. Whiteboard shows kural in Tamil script as he writes.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Ravi's hand moves smoothly across whiteboard, writing each line of kural; camera pans slightly to follow the writing.

shots.action_en: Both return to their desks. Priya types with new confidence. Ravi watches briefly with a smile, then focuses on his work. They work in focused, determined silence.
shots.camera_en: Wide shot of both desks, side by side, each absorbed in work.
shots.image_prompt_en: Wide shot of office cubicles showing Ravi and Priya at adjacent desks, both typing with focus and determination. Priya's posture is straight and confident. Sticky notes consolidated into one clear list. Warm window light mixes gently with cool fluorescent office lighting.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Priya types steadily with purpose; Ravi glances over with calm, satisfied smile, then focuses on work; both characters' shoulders relaxed now.

script.loop_note_en: The opening shot of Priya stressed at her desk echoes at the end when she types with new confidence. The story shows transformation from anxiety to decision, making it a complete character arc.
